what: STAND-IN for night fighting (-TheaterSeaNightFight, Tools/sea_waves/run_night.sh): Content/Data/SeaBattles/light-ships.json as recorded (tools/sea-record), the same views and events, with a night's light header added (field.light: sun -20, moon lit 0.3 up 25 from 140, vis 2500) until the rules send fleet actions' light. Not a booked result. RECORDING: a fleet action fought by the computer on both sides for the 3D scene to replay (tools/sea-record). Not a booked result: the campaign never reads it. Each view carries the zones only where they changed since the view before, and a piece's still fields (kind, name, nat, figures0, w; extra.cls, ships0, fleet) only the first time it shows.
